name: runA_shell
bash_commands: find . -path ./target -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && cat Cargo.toml && cat python_src/wordstats.py && cat src/*.rs && cat tests/spec.rs
cargo build 2>&1 | grep -E "^(error|warning)" ; cat .claude/settings.json; ls reports 2>&1

cargo fmt --check; echo "fmt=$?"; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "clippy=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; cargo test 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked|error"; echo "test=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
printf 'The cat and the hat. The CAT sat!\nA hat, a bat; a mat?' > /tmp/t.txt; python3 -I python_src/wordstats.py --top 3 < /tmp/t.txt; cargo run -q -- --top 3 < /tmp/t.txt

cargo fmt --check; echo "fmt=$?"; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings > /tmp/clippy.log 2>&1; echo "clippy=$?"; tail -5 /tmp/clippy.log; cargo test > /tmp/test.log 2>&1; echo "test=$?"; grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked|^error" /tmp/test.log
printf 'The cat and the hat. The CAT sat!\nA hat, a bat; a mat?' > /tmp/t.txt; python3 -I python_src/wordstats.py --top 3 < /tmp/t.txt; cargo run -q -- --top 3 < /tmp/t.txt
cargo fmt && cargo fmt --check && echo FMT_OK

printf 'The cat and the hat. The CAT sat!\nA hat, a bat; a mat?\nélan Élan ÉLAN "quoted" -- ...' > /tmp/wstext.txt && python3 -I python_src/wordstats.py --top 10 --min 1 < /tmp/wstext.txt > /tmp/py.out && cargo run -q -- --top 10 --min 1 < /tmp/wstext.txt > /tmp/rs.out && diff /tmp/py.out /tmp/rs.out && echo SAME
